words.sense: Relieving symptoms without curing the underlying cause.
misconceptions: Confused with placebo when the defining clue is overlooked.

words.sense: An inactive treatment whose apparent benefit chiefly reflects expectation.
misconceptions: Confused with palliative when the defining clue is overlooked.

semantic_axes.description: A palliative treatment has a symptom-relieving effect; a placebo lacks an active treatment and works chiefly through expectation.

edges.boundary_rule: A palliative treatment has a symptom-relieving effect; a placebo lacks an active treatment and works chiefly through expectation.
clues_a: Relieving symptoms without curing the underlying cause.
clues_b: Contains no active treatment despite perceived benefit.
An inactive treatment whose apparent benefit chiefly reflects expectation.

location or timing that does not change the decisive feature

misconceptions.M1: Treating palliative as though it always means placebo.

misconceptions.M3: Overvaluing a distracting detail instead of the decisive semantic distinction.
